title: Mixed Event — Unfading Wishing — Episode1 New Year's Eve Traditions

meta.Event Outline: The US trip is coming up fast, and Akito's been practicing at full throttle. He takes a well-earned break on New Year's Day, but while he's out and about, he ends up running into a certain someone...

rows.Line: New Year's Eve
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, here's to another great year in the books!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheers.
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's not much, but we prepared a few dishes.
Please feel free to have as much as you all like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Roast beef, gratin, sushi rolls and omelets... “Not much”, you say, but this is a pretty decadent spread.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We decided to roll up our sleeves after we heard that you'd all be throwing your party here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We also helped!
For example, we plated this salad!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We've even prepared some ice cream for dessert. You have your choice of rum raisin and mocha!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! Definitely rum raisin for me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'll try the mocha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, I could really go for some of that rum raisin right now! Can I start with that...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, hold your horses...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm guessing we're all hungry, since we just finished practicing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You had practice on New Year's Eve? I guess we shouldn't have expected otherwise, but you all seem really motivated!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Motivated, huh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I guess we are...
I mean, we can't waste any time just standing around.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I like the expressions on your faces, but do be careful not to push yourselves too hard. Make sure to take breaks when you can, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're doing just that!
Right, Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we don't have practice tomorrow, so An and I are going to go see the New Year's show at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They're doing a New Year's show?!
That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. This time, only during New Year's, Kagami Mochi Phenny is going to appear! I can't wait to see him!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. That seems like a nice way to spend New Year's.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, while we're on the subject, how are you guys all gonna spend New Year's?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. We're glad that you asked!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're gonna play Hanetsuki! Right, Rin?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We're gonna get revenge on Miku and MEIKO after losing to them last time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, KAITO, we're not letting you guys beat us either!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. Challenge accepted!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're not about to back down either.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honestly, you guys are like the only people I know who take Hanetsuki this seriously.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, Hanetsuki has been receiving quite a lot of attention in recent years...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As a competitive sport no less.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wow... I just did a quick search, and it looks way more intense than I initially thought.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It feels a lot like competitive badminton.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The way these paddles are designed may have something to do with that. It seems easier to keep rallies going, which would certainly increase the stakes of each game.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, and they look really cool!
I wanna try using one!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. Then, after we're done with our shrine visit, why don't we go visit a sporting goods store together?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, you mean it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Akito and I are both scheduled to be right near the mall tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it shouldn't take that long to go through all their Hanetsuki stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys are going to the mall?
Any plans to check out the New Year's sales?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, we're actually going to a cafe.
Akito's hoping to have some of their New Year's pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, Toya, they don't need to know that part.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha!
You're going to have pancakes on New Year's, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But those pancakes are going to allow us to play competitive Hanetsuki.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, Akito, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to play against you guys!
A few hours later
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yawn...
Still sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I couldn't stay awake. I might've gone a little overboard during practice earlier this morning...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hm? This smell...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito, are you awake?
I just made some New Year's soba.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I was wondering what that brothy smell was. It was this soba.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: It's just about ready, so would you mind getting Ena? She should be in her room.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, one second.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This still doesn't seem right...
I might be drawing the shadows wrong...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Ena, Mom made some soba and told me to come get you.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line:
I'm guessing you're still drawing...
I'm coming in, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Mom made some New Year's soba...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh?!
What's wrong with you, Akito?! Who said you could come in?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's your fault for not hearing me knock.
I'm here to tell you that Mom made some New Year's soba for us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Soba...? Wait, it's already that late?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, I've done my job.
I'm gonna go have my soba before it gets soggy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, fine. But I was just starting to find my groove...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh...
Actually, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're going over to the United States soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You guys are gonna try to take over the world or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Does that mean you'll be going overseas a lot in the future?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, there's a good chance of that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we're only going over to see an event during this trip.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What is it...?
If you have something to say, then say it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, nevermind...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I've lost my concentration, so I think I'll take a break and have some soba.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A break? You still plan on drawing afterwards...? Aren't you going to hang out with Momoi tomorrow? You're gonna oversleep if you stay up too late.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm almost done, so I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Plus, I'm really looking forward to hanging out with Airi tomorrow since it's been so long since we last did. There's no way I'm gonna oversleep.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The words of a person who uses her own brother as an alarm clock don't really hold much weight.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shut up!
Anyway, step aside! I don't want my soba to get soggy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you were the one who...

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line:
Mom!
Do we still have some of that soba spice mix?
